Test Case 4: Database org_id Population

This test verifies that execution records in SurrealDB have the org_id field properly populated when posted via API key authentication.

input.query: SELECT org_id, activity_id FROM activity_executions WHERE org_id = 'd98c6120-96a8-41ff-b0fe-835c0cc0d454' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
